limits: 18trials:16no-vector import trials and2majority-filter trials; retain all events and both rounds.
Import bulk verifies2queries/trial, small verifies20; timings are not a causal batching speed ratio.
Original protocol marks physical IO, CPU and temporary peak unavailable. Native resource streams are retained without changing that original protocol.
Whole-process maximum RSS is not per-phase RSS. Inner import timer includes required queries and assertions; do not sum commit/checkpoint diagnostics into it.
Majority-filter trials retain95000eligible vectors, scan100000, and use20measured samples/round. They are not new independent quality tasks.
The two retained Rust probes access same-crate measurement paths. Current replay needs a separately built temporary crate entry; no public CLI mode is added.
Exact synthetic text inputs can be regenerated using the separate preparation script and the132original input hashes; original binary/OS cache state are not reconstructed.
